name: LightSolutions Hilux DS8
summary: Recessed 8W tunable-white (2200-6000K) LED downlight with integrated Shelly Wi-Fi/BLE smart driver.

extra.certification: ETL Listed to UL 1598 / CSA C22.2 No. 250.0 (ETL, not UL mark)
extra.ble_remote_pairing: pairs directly with Shelly BLU remote
extra.kb_shared_with: HiluX DS4 US (4-inch, Ø120 trim, 106mm cutout) - same KB page, specs given per model

gotchas: Listed as unavailable/out of stock on us.shelly.com
Fixed 8W / 600 lm max — a small-aperture accent/detail light, not a main-room flood; DS4 variant is the 4-inch can size
Tunable white only (2200-6000K) — no RGB color
Certification is ETL to UL 1598, not a UL mark — fine for most inspectors but check if a spec requires UL
No power metering and no wired switch input; control via app, voice, or a paired Shelly BLU remote
best_for: Recessed ceiling lights where you want app-controlled tunable white without a separate smart switch
